dct_description_sm:
Records are from the CVC Terrestrial Monitoring Database, and only includes CVC collected data. The dataset only contains species occurrence data. CVC also collects data at these locations on tree health, downed woody debris, canopy cover, plant cover in the ground vegetation layer, and abundance by height class in regeneration layer. Contact us to request and receive these data.


 

Click for Metadata here: Forest Plant records metadata (2011-2025)


 

How to download this data:

1.Scroll down to the Layers section and click the layer name: ForestPlantRecords_2011_2025.

2.To download the whole dataset: click the Download button and choose your preferred format (CSV, Shapefile, GeoJSON, etc.).

3.To download only specific records:

  • Click Filter Data (top right).
  • Choose the field/attribute you want to filter by.
  • Set your filter criteria, then click on the Download button beneath the Filter Data.
  • Turn on Toggle Filters.
  • Choose your format and click Download for whichever format you desire.

 

💡 Tip: Clicking on a point on the map opens an attribute info window with details for that record. You can dock or undock this window.

NOTE: This dataset cannot be downloaded directly from ArcGIS Online; please use the CVC's Open Data portal to download the data.
